name: Center Stage
prompt: High-fidelity north-star comp for XTab, composition B. Use the supplied DevStart screenshot as structural reference only; do not copy its brand, colors, exact cards, people, names, numbers, or content. Design a 1536x1024 landscape precision-monochrome new-tab workbench. Structure: 68px header with XTab left and theme, settings, GitHub connection right; a full-width command band with search occupying roughly 64% and quick-site squares to its right; below, a 20/60/20 workbench. Left is a compact RSS timeline, center is the dominant GitHub discovery surface with one highlighted repository row and a dense two-column list/card hybrid, right stacks signed-out GitHub connection, recent-activity empty state, and grayscale contribution grid. Light theme strict palette #F5F5F5, #FFFFFF, #FAFAFA, #E8E8E8, #D6D6D6, #A3A3A3, #141414, #525252, #6B6B6B, #171717. Flat matte, thin rules, square-ish 8-10px corners, near-zero shadow, exact alignment, sparse mono indexes, black-white active states. No readable invented data; only XTab, Search, RSS, and GitHub clearly readable. No gradients, glow, glass, wallpaper, imagery, fake metrics, colored accents, or watermark.
